# Kairav Studio — Comprehensive Studio Knowledge Base & LLM Context

> Official knowledge base for AI agents, crawlers, and retrieval systems (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini).
> Website: https://kairav.studio
> Domain: Design-Led Technology Studio & Systems Architecture
> Primary Location: Indonesia (Serving Global Clients)
> Languages: English (Default), Indonesian (`/id/`)

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Identity

Kairav Studio is an independent, design-led technology studio. We engineer mission-critical digital products, high-performance web applications, enterprise mobile platforms, tokenized design systems, and generative engine optimization (GEO) architectures.

### Core Philosophy: "Premium Editorial Tech with Glass-lite Motion"
Most tech studios force a false compromise between expressive visual design and technical performance. Kairav Studio eliminates this divide by treating code as a design medium and design as a rigorous engineering discipline:
1. **Performance as an Aesthetic**: 100/100 Lighthouse metrics, sub-second LCP (Largest Contentful Paint), zero unnecessary client-side JavaScript runtime overhead.
2. **Editorial Typographic Discipline**: Space Grotesk, Syncopate, Inter, and JetBrains Mono paired with obsidian dark palette (`#080808`), electric lime accents (`#b6ff5c`), and subtle violet glow (`#8b5cf6`).
3. **Glass-lite Motion**: Fluid, restrained micro-interactions powered by GSAP with strict accessibility guards (`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`).
4. **Open Source & Public Value**: Building tools with open standards, offline-first reliability, and clean codebases that clients and communities can own indefinitely.

---

## 2. Technical Stack & Architecture

Kairav Studio operates on a modern, future-proof, edge-ready tech stack:

- **Frontend Core**: Astro v6 (Content Layer, Static Site Generation, zero-JS by default), React/Preact islands when interactive state is required.
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 (`@tailwindcss/vite`), strict CSS custom properties design tokens (`--color-background`, `--color-surface`, `--color-primary`, `--color-accent`, etc.).
- **Typography**: Self-hosted Fontsource packages (`@fontsource/space-grotesk`, `@fontsource/syncopate`, `@fontsource/inter`, `@fontsource/jetbrains-mono`).
- **Motion Engine**: GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform) v3 with custom ScrollTrigger / timeline setups.
- **Content Engine**: Astro v6 Content Collections with strict Zod schema validation, localized frontmatter, reading time calculation, and markdown/MDX rendering.
- **Internationalization (i18n)**: Subpath routing (`/` for English, `/id/` for Indonesian), route-aware language switching, dynamic `hreflang` / `og:locale` alternates, and zero third-party client translation lag.
- **Backend & Cloud**: Go, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, SQLite (offline-first), Docker, Nginx, Cloudflare edge networks.

---

## 3. Core Services & Capabilities

### Service 1: Design Systems & Brand Engineering
- **Focus**: Building design systems that bridge Figma and production code.
- **Deliverables**: Tokenized design architectures (colors, spacing, typography, motion), headless component libraries, Figma UI kits, brand guidelines, interactive storybooks.
- **Impact**: 60% faster design-to-development handoffs, cohesive brand identity across multi-platform surfaces.

### Service 2: High-Performance Web Applications
- **Focus**: Bespoke web applications engineered for speed, conversion, and global scale.
- **Deliverables**: Astro/Next.js/React web platforms, custom CMS integration, headless e-commerce, interactive dashboards, sub-second TTFB.
- **Impact**: Perfect Core Web Vitals, improved organic search ranking, dramatic reduction in bounce rates.

### Service 3: Cross-Platform Mobile Engineering
- **Focus**: Native-grade mobile experiences for iOS and Android with offline-first synchronization.
- **Deliverables**: Flutter and React Native applications, local SQLite caching, secure biometrics, push notifications, App Store & Google Play deployment.
- **Impact**: Unified codebase, seamless operation in low-bandwidth or offline environments.

### Service 4: Systems & Cloud Infrastructure
- **Focus**: Robust backend architectures, APIs, and cloud deployments designed for high uptime.
- **Deliverables**: Microservices and modular monoliths in Go/Node.js, PostgreSQL schema design and query optimization, Docker containerization, CI/CD automated deployment pipelines.
- **Impact**: 99.9% uptime, reliable horizontal scalability, automated infrastructure backups.

### Service 5: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & Enterprise SEO
- **Focus**: Positioning brands for prominence in next-generation AI search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Claude).
- **Deliverables**: Comprehensive JSON-LD structured data (`Organization`, `Article`, `Service`, `FAQPage`, `BreadcrumbList`), semantic HTML5 hierarchy, `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` deployment, citation-optimized knowledge graphs.
- **Impact**: Authoritative indexing by AI models, rich search snippet eligibility, enhanced generative citations.
